goal.what: Whoever builds or changes rn, a person or an AI, derives each part's specification from this document and implements it on the same framework and principles, so rn gives the person the UX in dev/rn/ux.md whatever the implementation.
grounds: steering T46: rn on the new turn

decisions.what: How does rn deliver its UX, in a few sentences?
decisions.decided: The orchestrator, rn's one AI that talks with the person, decides every move from the steering kept by rn's scripts, and has turn make every work but the plan and the learnings; rn is built against the work drifting from the purpose and the AI drifting as the work goes on.
grounds: steering T46: "carries a run over many turns without drift ... and calls turn for each work"

decisions.what: What keeps every task on the purpose?
decisions.decided: Principle: every task traces back to the goal or a criterion, and its result is checked against them.
grounds: steering: each task "Serves AC1" or AC2

decisions.what: How are the points to ask found and ordered?
decisions.decided: Principle: the points are asked down a design tree, from the purpose down, only those no fact or the purpose settles, one per message, in the order they rest on one another.
grounds: steering T46: "by grilling the user down a design tree"; the document before this pass had no such principle
turn-rebuild.md, Design tree (KAOS; Brooks; Matt Pocock's grilling skill)

decisions.what: How does the plan stay true to the facts?
decisions.decided: Principle: the plan is made again from the checked facts after each task.
grounds: steering T46: "replanned from each move's facts"

decisions.what: What is carried from move to move?
decisions.decided: Principle: only the steering; what each work is made from comes from the record, in ACC's shape.
grounds: steering T46: "keeping its state compressed from move to move" (ACC, arXiv 2601.11653)

decisions.decided: Principle: only what the person typed, /rn:ty or /rn:gm, found in Claude Code's record after the proposal.
grounds: dev/architecture.md, The caller approves what is theirs

decisions.what: Who mends a work turn returns?
decisions.decided: Principle: the orchestrator fixes none; a shortfall is settled as a decision and turn makes the work again.
grounds: turn-rebuild.md: a work is never passed by the one who made it

decisions.what: Which user stories carry the UX's steps?
decisions.decided: Six: ask with /rn:up; answer each point; approve or ask a change; each work made to the goal; go on another day with /rn:up alone; decide each learning and get the pull request ready.
grounds: dev/rn/ux.md:25-54; the going-on story added with the UX's step in 462dcc2c

decisions.what: Which roles, each with its technology?
decisions.decided: The orchestrator [AI · main conversation, Markdown]; the compressor [AI · subagent, Markdown]; turn [plugin · Claude Code]; rn's scripts [scripts · Python 3.9]; GitHub outside; boxes hold only names and tags.
grounds: architecture.json Q4 and the components part: a box holds its name and a tag, no sentence; the figure before this pass held sentences and called the person user

decisions.what: What does each role alone decide?
decisions.decided: The orchestrator talks with the person and decides each move, writing the plan and the learnings with turn's plan template open; the compressor gives what of a CCS needs judgment; rn's scripts write the steering and each CCS, make proposals and take typed answers; turn makes every other work.
grounds: steering T42: every checklist remade as a template turn keeps, so rn's plan checklist becomes turn's plan template

decisions.what: How do the data join, and what does a CCS hold?
decisions.decided: The data model: steering, plan, task, CCS with decisions, choices, the template copy and the result; a CCS in ACC's shape names its receiver.
grounds: dev/rn/data-model.svg, read as source; checklist renamed template as T42 makes them

decisions.what: What sequence does each story follow?
decisions.decided: A Mermaid sequence for asking, a sign-off, a work made by turn, going on another day, and the learnings; the asking split down a design tree.
grounds: plugins/rn/prompts/orchestrator.md:104-125: a waiting sign-off is shown again, else Next's step is taken

decisions.what: Where does each part run and keep its files?
decisions.decided: On Claude Code with python3, git, jq and gh, turn installed with rn; .rn/<yyyymmdd>-<slug>/ on the work's branch; the person's additions in .turn/templates/, kept by turn; rn ships no checklists.
grounds: dev/turn/architecture.md: kept templates in .turn/templates/ in the folder Claude Code runs in

decisions.what: Which tests cover each unit, and when do they pass?
decisions.decided: rn's scripts by unit, property and mutation tests; each move by a trial from a state made beforehand; the whole by the acceptance test on lovaizu/playground, an AI holding what the person truly wants.

decisions.what: Which choices would a developer question?
decisions.decided: The compressor in the foreground, turn:up in the background; scripts tested in full, as a failure loses days of record or takes an approval never given.

decisions.what: What keeps the document true while a role changes inside?
decisions.decided: Lines say responsibilities, relations and choices with reasons; steps stay in the prompts, fields in the forms.
